title: Info.plist Speech Recognition Key
requirements: Add NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription to Resources/Info.plist with the value: "Diary Transcriber uses speech recognition to transcribe your diary entries into text."
Verify the key is recognized by plutil — run `plutil -p Resources/Info.plist` and confirm the key is present in the final Info.plist
Ensure NSMicrophoneUsageDescription remains in the right bundle path — no regression to the existing key
acceptance_criteria: plutil confirms NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription is present in the final Info.plist
No system speech-recognition prompt appears without a rationale string
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription remains in the correct position
out_of_scope: Onboarding calls-to-action for the privacy keys
